title: Degreewise relative exchange with a coefficient map
statement: For a commutative square and F,F′,φ as in [def-kun-relative-higher-image-derived-map], and q≥0, define g*H^q(Rf_*F[0])→H^q(Rf′_*F′[0]) by the exact inverse-image homology comparison followed by H^q of [def-kun-relative-higher-image-derived-map]. This is precisely the original relativeHigherDirectImageExchange construction, moved without changing its body. Conventions and constructions: [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-kun-commutative-derived-exchange], [pqf-def-affine-morphism], [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-kun-relative-higher-image-derived-map].

lean.statement:
def relativeHigherDirectImageExchange
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : CommSq g' f' f g)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (F' : Sheaf X'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g').obj F ⟶ F') (q : ℕ) :
    (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor
        (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℤ)).obj
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor
            (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0).obj F))) ⟶
    (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor
      (Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℤ)).obj
      ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f').obj
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor
          (Sheaf X'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0).obj F'))
